title: Credit limits
hint: Limit, used (open invoices + orders not yet invoiced), available, and what waits for credit.
rules: Over the limit, an order, a release or a shipment is shown and goes on, unless a credit rule in Admin › Automation › Approval rules makes it wait for someone's yes. Nobody approves their own request.
wording: The wording of the credit rule on documents waits for the accountant's word; these are the defaults.

noAccess.title: Credit limits
noAccess.body: Credit limits need the permission {permission}. Ask a person who manages roles.

noPrice: Amounts need the price grain ({permission}): the list shows who has a limit and what waits.
search: Search a customer by code or name

empty.title: No credit limits set
empty.body: Without a limit nothing is checked, as before. Set one with Change limit on a customer's row of this list, once a customer buys on terms.

noMatch.title: No customer matches
noMatch.body: Change the search or the view.

change.title: Change the credit limit of {name}
change.amountHint: In {currency}. Leave it empty and choose Clear the limit to check nothing.
change.reasonHint: One line, kept in the log of this customer.

consequence.rechecked: Orders waiting for credit are checked again at once: those within the new limit go on.
consequence.cleared: Without a limit, nothing is checked for this customer with this company.
consequence.logged: The change and its reason are kept in the log.

problem.amount: Type the limit as an amount, for example 25.000,00.
problem.reason: Say why the limit changes, in one line.

change.doneRechecked_one: {name}: credit limit saved; {count} order waiting for credit went on.
change.doneRechecked_other: {name}: credit limit saved; {count} orders waiting for credit went on.
change.noCustomers: No customer of this company yet.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.change: Change the limit of the focused customer

problem.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again.
problem.forbidden: You don't have the permission for this.
problem.not_found: Not found: it may have been removed.
problem.unavailable: The server cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
problem.rate_limited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.invalid: This was refused as it is: check what you entered.
